questions_and_answers.question_text: Look at the menu. The instructor asks where a certain section of items is written. Answer by pointing to the section and saying 'Koko desu.' Example: Sofuto dorinku wa doko desu ka? (Where are the soft drinks?) -> Koko desu. (pointing to the Soft Drinks section). Now answer: Furesshu juusu wa doko desu ka? (Where are the fresh juices?)

answers.answer_text: Koko desu. (pointing to the フレッシュ・ジュース / Fresh Juice section)

questions_and_answers.question_text: The instructor asks: A la karuto wa doko desu ka? (Where is the A La Carte section?) Answer by pointing and saying 'Koko desu.'

answers.answer_text: Koko desu. (pointing to the ア・ラ・カルト / A La Carte section)
